name: s3ReadBinary
description: Reads an object from an S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket and returns its body as a binary value.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket to read from.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Read an object as binary
examples.description: Returns the raw bytes of the object.
